scope.auxiliary_model_role: proposal or rollout only; compute is reported separately

attempts.comparison: one-shot conditional SIR at matched candidate-rollout groups
attempts.decision_basis: 8 questions x 2 draws: best i-SIR arm reached 25.0% versus 37.5% for existing conditional IS and used 2.34x main-model FLOPs per draw

attempts.comparison: uniform suffix length at matched questions, draws, alpha, block size and MH update count
attempts.decision_basis: 32 questions x 4 draws: multiscale improved accuracy by 5.47 pp, reduced generated tokens by 32.3%, and reduced aggregate wall time by 40.7%; its clustered accuracy difference interval was [-2.34, 14.84] pp and it was selected by the preregistered accuracy-first rule
attempts.confirmation_selection_rule: among arms passing the registered gate, choose the highest accuracy and break ties by lower wall time

attempts.comparison: uniform suffix schedule with a base-only proposal at matched model, prompt, chain count, update count, block size and reward
attempts.decision_basis: three paired RTX 3090 seeds: multiscale plus frozen replay used 0.357x online wall time and 1.002x main-model FLOPs, raised acceptance from 61.5% to 80.2%, and remained faster after adding cache construction for the first query in all three seeds
attempts.deployment_condition: the replay library is frozen before the chain starts and belongs to the same prompt and policy version
attempts.compute_accounting: cache construction, online target-model FLOPs and wall time are reported separately; this experiment has no FLOPs break-even because online FLOPs are 0.2% above the base-only arm

attempts.comparison: independent rollout uniforms at identical rollout count
attempts.decision_basis: rerun on 8 questions x 2 draws: accuracy was unchanged at 18.75%, wall time was 1.013x, main-model FLOPs were 1.021x, and descriptive ESS was essentially unchanged despite 8.5% lower within-point-set log-weight dispersion

attempts.comparison: iid and token-level scrambled-Sobol rollouts at identical candidate and rollout counts
attempts.decision_basis: 8 questions x 2 draws: accuracy remained 18.75%; descriptive ESS increased 6.5% and within-point-set log-weight dispersion fell 29.1%, but wall time was 1.044x and main-model FLOPs were 1.042x
attempts.marginal_property: each arithmetic rollout has exactly the configured proposal marginal; dependence only couples rollouts within one candidate

attempts.decision_basis: 8 questions x 2 draws: all 16 paired candidates, selected indices and outputs matched exactly; 8.27% of rollouts were skipped, but evaluation batches increased from 63 to 102, main-model FLOPs increased 16.4%, and wall time increased 39.8%
attempts.reward_requirement: fixed pointwise reward with deterministic finite log-weight bounds

attempts.comparison: ordinary Qwen2.5-1.5B autoregressive rollout with identical sampling distribution
attempts.decision_basis: 8 questions x 2 draws: K=2 was the best assisted arm but used 1.058x wall time, delivered 0.952x output-token throughput, used 1.055x main-model FLOPs and 1.439x total FLOPs despite 86.5% draft acceptance; K=4 and K=8 were slower still
attempts.compute_accounting: Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-0.5B forward token slots and dense FLOPs are reported separately

attempts.decision_basis: existing three-seed RTX 3090 result: lower wall time with statistically unchanged request outputs

attempts.comparison: fresh-only conditional rollout after cache construction is amortized
attempts.decision_basis: existing result: lower warm-online FLOPs and wall time when matching unused history is already available; history construction is a separate cold-start cost, and the old seven-query arithmetic intersection is not a default single-use replay claim

attempts.comparison: sequential fresh-only and sequential warm replay at matched Qwen2.5-1.5B candidates, rollout budget, prompts and random streams
attempts.decision_basis: three paired FP32 RTX 3090 seeds: candidate reuse used 0.696x replay-online wall time and 0.807x main-model FLOPs; adding continuous batching used 0.502x wall time with a 1.095x local total-FLOP factor; the complete online stack used 0.686x wall time, 0.746x main-model FLOPs and 0.909x total FLOPs versus continuous-batched fresh-only execution; all execution-equivalent pairs were token-exact
attempts.auxiliary_model_accounting: Qwen2.5-0.5B is used only for off-policy rollouts and is reported separately
attempts.deployment_condition: enable warm replay only for matching evaluation records that have not been consumed; if history must be constructed for the current request, continuous-batched fresh-only execution remains the default
attempts.cold_start_result: new history construction plus the first query used 1.266x wall time and 1.945x total FLOPs versus continuous-batched fresh-only execution
